newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil up at close, outlook seen positive.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil up at close, outlook seen positive.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Jun (3rd pos) 1,250 rgt/tonne Apr (south) 1,300
Prev settlement 1,246 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices finished a shade higher after drifting erratically, with talk of supportive data, soyoil gains and technical buying helping sentiment. June futures closed at 1,250 ringgit, after falling to 1,245 low. June is likely to test 1,260 on Friday. Volume also picked on late covering.
PALM PHYSICAL - Also traded in line with futures, with interest more widespread in CPOs and products sector.
June futures contract ended four ringgit up at 1,250 ringgit ($499.20) a tonne after drifting in a 12-ringgit range.
Most futures contracts posted small gains.
Morning sentiment was boosted by the firmness in soyoil.

"There was talk that export for the first 10 days of April is estimated at between 203,000 and 206,000 tonnes. The export data was seen supportive," a trader said, adding that players were covering positions on speculation of higher prices.
"June futures contract has already broken out from its range of 1,230-1,250 in earlier trade before moving uncertainly," a chartist said.
Traders said players may be adopting a cautious attitude ahead of the release of official March crop data by Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority on April 15.
In physicals, dealing was more active.
Physicals April (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,300 ringgit vs bids of 1,297.50 after trading at 1,300 earlier.
April (central) saw offers at 1,285 vs bids 1,280 with earlier dones seen at 1,285 and 1,282.50.
May (south) was offered at 1,295 and bids at 1,290 with earlier trades done from 1,292.50 to 1,295.
May (central) saw sellers at 1,280 and bids at 1,277.50.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $547.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May $542.50, June at $540 and July/Aug/Sept at $535. May was traded at $543.50 and $542.50.
Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $584, May at $580, June at $575 and July/Aug/Sept at $570. April was dealt at $582.50, May at $580 and June at $575.
Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $440 and May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.
